sloka: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा ।जनकः प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् उवाच मुनिपुंगवौ ॥१-७२-९॥
transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mate tadā ।janakaḥ prāṁjaliḥ vākyam uvāca munipuṁgavau ॥1-72-9॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Viswamitra which echoed the wish of Vasishta, Janaka replied to the eminent ascetics with folded palms.
